title: CueFX warning
description: What validate (and analyze, and a render result) reports. Degrade, don't fail: only severity 'error' blocks a render.

id.description: stable within one response: code plus the first frame or the field path

message.description: plain language, from the code's template; frames shown inclusive

detail.description: the backend's technical text (field path first); for logs and tooltips

frames.description: [start, end): end excluded; null when the warning is not about frames

jump.description: frame to jump to; frames[0] when there are frames

cause.description: kind: field {path} | setting {path} | track | pass {index} | timing | tool-draw | render (v2.4: a note from a render step)
